role: Property owner in Terminal Yard area
stance_basis: mentioned only as a property owner whose land would be acquired; no stated position on the project
summary: Erie-Lackawanna Railroad is mentioned solely as the owner of land between the Delaware, Lackawanna & Western Railroad depot and South Park Avenue, which would be acquired as part of the Terminal Yard site. The document does not record any statement, comment, or position from Erie-Lackawanna Railroad regarding the project. The entity appears only in a factual description of property ownership relevant to potential acquisitions.
summary_quote: Acquisitions for the yard and service facilities (Table 5-6 and 9-1) would include the Delaware, Lackawanna & Western Railroad depot (presently City-owned), a portion of the City-owned block bounded by South Park Avenue and Main, Perry, and Washington Streets, portions of the privately-owned blocks bounded by South Park Avenue and Washington, Perry, and Illinois Streets, and the land between the depot and South Park Avenue (owned by the Erie-Lackawanna Railroad)
